purpose: Review a finite catalog of six residual algorithmic, event-process, nonlinear-dependence, distribution-distance, relative-state and quarterly-model mechanisms against the frozen 155-definition library and 142 numerical comparators before reading any protected value.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_return_direction_lz76_complexity_238s
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.hypothetical_formula: Encode within-half return directions and summarize incremental Lempel-Ziv dictionary growth over the fixed sequence.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.parameters: proposed sign alphabet, phrase parsing rule and length normalization
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: The complete library already contains return-direction dictionary phrase count, weak-order entropy, price-update share and weak-order time-reversal states. Changing the parser and normalization estimates the same symbolic compressibility state rather than introducing a new observation.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_high_amount_event_hawkes_branching_ratio_240m
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.hypothetical_formula: Threshold high-amount minutes and fit a self-exciting point-process branching ratio to their event times.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.parameters: proposed amount threshold, kernel family, decay and likelihood fit
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Top-decile event-spacing entropy, above-median longest run, amount local-peak density and peak recency already consume event timing and clustering. Threshold, kernel and likelihood choices add a point-process fit to that terminal family.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_return_amount_distance_covariance_238p
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.hypothetical_formula: Measure nonlinear dependence between within-half signed returns and aligned endpoint log amount using distance covariance.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.parameters: proposed distance-covariance normalization and finite-sample correction
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Return-amount correlation, amount conditioning, mutual-information review, tail-copula review, signed cumulative path area and cross-spectral phase already consume synchronous and lagged nonlinear dependence. Distance covariance changes only the dependence estimator.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_morning_afternoon_transaction_price_wasserstein_distance_120b
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.hypothetical_formula: Compare volume-weighted morning and afternoon log transaction-price distributions with a Wasserstein distance.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.parameters: proposed transport order, weights and scale normalization
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Transaction-price consensus, weighted skew, two-half dispersion resolution and rejected morning-afternoon distribution-overlap proposals already terminate this information state. Wasserstein order and normalization are alternate distribution-distance choices.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_cross_sectional_return_rank_mobility_entropy_238p
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.hypothetical_formula: Rank each stock's synchronous minute return cross-sectionally and summarize within-stock rank-state mobility over the fixed session.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.parameters: proposed rank bins, transition support and entropy normalization
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: The library contains cross-sectional standardized-return state stability and several leave-one-out market synchronization factors, while a prior cross-sectional cumulative-rank occupancy proposal was rejected before values. Rank binning and transition entropy reopen that same relative-state path family.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: quarterly_quality_state_hidden_markov_persistence_4q
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.hypothetical_formula: Discretize the four accepted quarterly quality fields and fit a finite hidden-state transition model to recent disclosures.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.parameters: proposed state alphabet, hidden-state count, transition fit and persistence score
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Quarterly quality levels, accelerations, rank gaps, growth floors, timing consistency and complete-library fitted models already consume the available state and transition information. State discretization and hidden-state count add post-exposure fitting freedom without a new source field.

selection.reason: All six proposals replace a symbolic parser, event threshold/model, dependence estimator, distribution metric, relative-state operator or fitted quarterly-state model inside already terminal information families.

decision.next_campaign_requirement: Continue only from a genuinely new finite prevalue mechanism or a separately accepted historically versioned point-in-time source whose original collection contract permits the proposed use.
